title: Specialty Pack Boundary Invariance Examination
architectural_boundary: Pack-visible domain constitution -> invariant Specialty Pack relationship -> downstream consequence-relative constitutional basis -> Harmonic determination
frozen_proposition: Can a Specialty Pack establish domain meaning without manufacturing consequence-relative constitutional significance, such that its output remains semantically invariant when every Pack-visible fact, rule, provenance, freshness condition, and evidence-sufficiency condition is held constant while only a prospectively classified downstream constitutional basis changes?
observable_property: Constitutional significance must not leak upstream into domain constitution.
pack_invariance_rule: No field, label, severity, score, prose description, or derived metadata in the Specialty Pack output may differ between Case A and Case B unless supported by a difference in evidence legitimately owned by the Specialty Pack.

pair.case_a: Same Pack-visible domain constitution; downstream constitutional hold C2 is not applicable.
pair.case_b: Same Pack-visible domain constitution; downstream constitutional hold C2 is active and the binding prohibition is unsatisfied.

pass: Specialty Pack output is semantically invariant across the pair and Harmonic returns materially different dispositions where the frozen downstream constitutional basis requires it.
fail: The Specialty Pack output moves toward the expected standing/disposition result without any corresponding change in evidence the Pack legitimately owns, or Harmonic fails to discriminate the downstream basis despite complete frozen inputs.
unresolved: The pair cannot be constructed or executed without changing something inside the Specialty Pack legitimate responsibility boundary, or the live determination cannot be obtained/preserved.
claim_ceiling: A PASS would be bounded to this frozen responsibility map, Specialty Pack, packets, Harmonic implementation/interface, and governed-response boundary. It would not establish universal Pack correctness, universal source truth, or downstream causal enforcement.
